Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the action items we agreed on related to HIPAA / PHI handling: 

- BAA: You asked whether Redwood will sign a BAA — short answer: yes, we do. We can start with our standard BAA and iterate if you have specific contractual requirements.
- PHI boundary guidance: We confirmed you plan to send clinical notes and patient identifiers for inference in two modes: (1) Hosted API (multi-tenant) with contractual BAA and data protection controls, and (2) Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) for workflows requiring stronger isolation.
- Eligible deployment modes: Based on your compliance needs, both Hosted (with BAA + contractual controls + dedicated tenancy options) and Private (VPC/on-prem) are options; we generally recommend Private for regulated workflows that require full network isolation and customer-managed keys.
- SOC 2 / security posture: You requested current SOC 2 status and an initial vendor security questionnaire — I'll attach the questionnaire and our BAA draft and loop in security for answers to technical questions.

Next steps (owners/times):
1) I attached our standard BAA draft and the security questionnaire (HC_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). Please confirm any clauses you want us to review (Sarah). (Action: Sarah, by Fri 9/1)
2) Redwood security to complete questionnaire sections that are technical (Action: Dev Patel, Evelyn Hart — target 9/1).
3) Schedule a 30-minute follow-up to walk through the questionnaire responses and deployment options (Action: Marissa — propose times).

Attachments: HC_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, Redwood_BAA_draft_2028.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally and send over proposed times.

Best,

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. Short answers below and I populated the technical tabs in HC_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (see attached). Highlights: 

- SOC 2: We completed our latest Type II SOC 2 audit on 2028-05-12. I'll share the redacted report link to HealthCloud's security mailbox once Evelyn confirms (we prefer an NDA for full report).

- Encryption / KMS: Hosted (our standard API) encrypts in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed KMS is available for Redwood Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted we offer envelope encryption with customer key support for Dedicated instances; fully customer-managed KMS for true Bring-Your-Own-Key is only available in Private (VPC/on-prem).

- PHI handling / retention: By default Redwood does not persist request bodies long-term. For Hosted: transient KV cache and prefix caching are used for performance; by default logs and short-term telemetry may contain non-persisted metadata (latency, token counts). We can disable telemetry and persist none of the request payloads; options are: 
  - Pilot Hosted with BAA + telemetry disabled (recommended for pilot).
  - Private (VPC) for production with customer-managed keys and no outbound logging to Redwood-managed telemetry systems.

- Deployment guidance: For HealthCloud's described flow (pilot de-id -> production limited PHI), recommended path is Hosted pilot (fast onboarding) + Private production migration. We can support data migration and pinned model versions during rollout.

Attachments: Completed HC_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (technical tabs filled).

Next steps: Marissa - propose two times this week for a 30-min security walk-through; I'll be available Fri 9/1 9:00-11:00 PT.

Cheers,
